rationale: The Court is likely to hold that § 1155’s “may…at any time…for what he deems…good and sufficient cause” is a statute-specified discretionary decision, triggering § 1252(a)(2)(B)(ii) and barring jurisdiction over challenges that would second-guess the revocation determination. The majority will probably add a narrowing caveat preserving only genuinely independent constitutional or purely legal claims not presented here, prompting a Sotomayor/Jackson dissent emphasizing the presumption of reviewability for ultra vires or legal-limit errors.
